acceptance_signals: Resolved journey mcpj-f8d4eaea8b9e4f24888d0072e44c0f30 and a matching human-admitted task exist before implementation writes.
A create-only task-start scope baseline is captured before repair writes.
The fixed controller passes only normalized exact manifest paths and identities through the internal caller request; the external controller request remains unchanged.
The driver launches no Git subprocess and requires no PATH while re-deriving distribution inputs and validating exact path count, path digest, and content digest before short-root allocation.
Any invalid or drifted manifest fact stops at driver preflight with action attempts zero, no short-root allocation, no evidence write, and no cleanup claim.
Caller and controller preserve one readiness attempt, at most one driver attempt, and at most one artifact action attempt.
Harmless tests prove successful fact propagation, Git-free driver preflight, drift rejection, privacy-bounded reports, and zero retry.
Focused controller/caller/driver tests, the combined artifact chain, documentation tests, and the full supported suite pass.
The repair task performs no real controller replay, build, evidence creation, or cleanup; that requires a separate admitted replay task.
Only admitted files change and every pre-existing excluded path and unrelated scope baseline remains byte-identical.
No network, dependency installation, Git mutation, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, public CLI, scheduler, or generic framework is introduced.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-064c96dd4a2b487b867d449acafa843d and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Implement the human-selected direction from resolved journey mcpj-f8d4eaea8b9e4f24888d0072e44c0f30. Extend only the internal controller-to-caller-to-driver request so the controller-bound exact manifest path list, path count, path digest, and content digest reach the driver. Before short-root allocation, the driver must re-derive distribution inputs and revalidate exact path and content identities using repository files only, without launching Git or requiring PATH. Preserve the external controller request, no-retry behavior, build action, evidence format, and evidence-gated cleanup. Add harmless tests and documentation. Validate this repair only; do not run the real replay in this task.

items: The internal caller and driver request contracts change together; incomplete propagation must fail closed and be fixture-protected.
Filesystem identities are point-in-time observations; actual driver validation must occur immediately before root allocation.
Pre-existing dirty-worktree files under broad included prefixes are preservation-only unless explicitly changed by this repair.
The Harness remains containment rather than a security sandbox.
A passing repair does not prove the later real build, evidence, cleanup, cross-platform behavior, repeated reliability, interviewer response, adoption, time savings, or return on investment.
Reviewed assumption: derive_distribution_inputs and canonical digest helpers inspect repository files without invoking Git.
Reviewed assumption: The fixed controller-bound manifest facts were already validated once with the Git-backed checker before Harness invocation.
Reviewed assumption: The controller worker source can pass normalized manifest paths and identities through the existing private caller request without changing external input.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the separately admitted post-repair real replay will pass readiness, build, evidence, and cleanup.
